tool.title: A stem separation tool
tool.description: Split any song into separate parts: vocals, drums, bass and the rest.
tool.author: user

suggestions.text: Make it work as a plugin inside music software
suggestions.why: Producers can split a track without leaving their session.

load.title: Load a song
load.description: Pick a song file to work on.
load.author: user

decision.text: Reads WAV, MP3 and FLAC files.
decision.why: Covers almost every song people have. Reading these comes built into the plugin toolkit.

alternatives.label: Any audio or video file
alternatives.text: Reads any audio or video file and pulls out the sound.
needs: An extra library to read video files

split.title: Split into stems
split.description: Vocals, drums, bass and everything else, as separate tracks.
split.author: user

decision.text: Uses an online separation service (an API) with an existing AI model.
decision.why: Fastest to build, with good results. Trade-offs: it costs money per song, needs internet, and the song leaves the user's computer.

alternatives.label: Run it on the user's computer instead
alternatives.text: Runs an AI model on the user's computer.
needs: A separation model you are allowed to ship

suggestions.why: Faint drums in the vocal stem are the most common complaint about stem splitters.

listen.title: Listen to each stem
listen.description: Play the stems on their own or together.
listen.author: user

decision.text: Solo and mute buttons for each stem, with a waveform.
decision.why: This is how most music tools let you check separate parts.

alternatives.label: Just play and stop per stem
alternatives.text: One play button per stem, nothing else.

save.title: Save the stems
save.description: Keep each stem as its own file.
save.author: user

decision.text: Saves each stem as a WAV file named after the song.
decision.why: WAV keeps full quality and every music tool can open it.

alternatives.label: Let people choose WAV or MP3
alternatives.text: People choose WAV or MP3 when saving.

s-up.title: Send the song to a separation service
s-up.description: An existing AI model, run online.
s-up.author: ai
needs: An account with a separation service (costs per song)

s-model.title: Include the separation model
s-model.description: The AI model ships with the tool. It is about 300 MB.
s-model.author: user

questions.text: Should the model be inside the installer, or download the first time someone uses the tool?
questions.why: It trades download size against needing internet once. That's a product call.

options.label: Download on first use (needs internet once)
needs: Somewhere to host the model file

s-lib.title: Model runtime library
s-lib.description: A ready-made library that runs AI models on a computer. One node stands for the whole library.
s-lib.author: ai

l2.title: Run the model on some audio
l2.author: doc

s-gpu.title: Use the graphics card if there is one
s-gpu.description: Much faster. Falls back to the processor.
s-gpu.author: user

s-run.title: Work through the song in 10-second pieces
s-run.description: Shows progress as it goes and keeps memory use low.
s-run.author: user

bleed.title: Reduce bleed between stems
bleed.description: Lower what each stem picks up from the others.
bleed.author: ai

backing.title: Separate lead and backing vocals
backing.description: Two vocal stems instead of one.
backing.author: ai

plugin.title: Works as a plugin
plugin.description: Runs inside music software, on a track.
plugin.author: ai

questions.text: Which music software should it work in?
questions.why: Plugin formats differ: VST3 works in most, and Logic Pro needs AU. Only you know your audience.

options.label: Ableton, FL Studio and others (VST3)
needs: A VST3 build of the plugin

options.label: Logic Pro (AU)
needs: An AU build, signed for macOS

options.label: Both
needs: A VST3 build of the plugin
An AU build, signed for macOS

p1.title: Shows up in the plugin list
p1.description: People add it to a track like any other effect.
p1.author: ai

p2.title: Takes audio from its track
p2.description: No need to load a file.
p2.author: ai

p3.title: Sends each stem to its own track
p3.description: So people can mix them right away.
p3.author: ai
